title: Phone profiling waits until the phone is free
why: Your question, Oct 26: where should the Oct 25 lesson live (xctrace record on Shivinate XIII timed out 'waiting for device to boot' until devicectl ddiServices ran)? claude-settings, ios-ship, or the Degen repo only?
note: Checked Oct 26 at claude-settings 149f4bc: ios-ship has testflight and install, no profile job; nothing calls xctrace. Live test, Oct 26 22:30-22:38 CDT, on the Mac (Xcode 27.1 27A9275, macOS 27.0, iPhone Shivinate XIII on iOS 27.1, network transport, by UDID): DDI already mounted and usable before any mount command; recording 1 passed; recording 2, about 17 s after recording 1 ended, failed 'Timed out waiting for device to boot' (exit 13) with the DDI still mounted, while devicectl showed the phone 'connected' instead of 'available (paired)'; after 5 min the phone was 'available (paired)' again and recording 3 passed. Finding: the DDI is not the cause, so ddiServices is not the fix; the Oct 25 success after ddiServices was most likely the wait it added. Likely cause: the phone stays held for a while after a recording. Unmeasured: how long (between 17 s and 5 min); whether a wired phone or another phone behaves the same; whether a wait for 'available (paired)' is enough every time. Web, Oct 26: the same message is a known intermittent xctrace failure since Xcode 13 (developer.apple.com/forums/thread/694698), seen on iOS 27 by others (github.com/seedds/nxnative/issues/142). General, not Degen's: the failure comes before the app launches. Owner, Oct 26: test first, then an ios-ship profile job. The test changed the fix, so the new shape needs the owner's word. Advisor pick: ios-ship 'profile' job: wait until devicectl lists the phone 'available (paired)' (capped, then exit 75), record by UDID, and retry once after a wait if xctrace prints 'Waiting for device to boot'. After c47 part 1 (both edit bin/ios-ship). Not a hook, not a CLAUDE.md rule.
